articles.detail: 5 cycles, all completed; avg 12 published per cycle; 1 quarantined

experiment: Skipped. No experiment is active, and the pause gate (`noNewExperimentsUntil` 2026-11-05) bars a new one. Nothing was evaluated or changed.
weakestArea: Science is 3 against a target of 5, down from 5 yesterday. Two of the three are weather and climate (Montreal smoke warnings, El Niño) and one is Tibetan snow and the monsoon; none came from Science, STAT or a health outlet, although Ebola in Nigeria was covered as politics. Under the 2026-09-26 decision, the science floor may go unmet, so the fix is wider science sources, not a higher floor. Al Jazeera Online is the source on 12 of 61 stories (19.7%), the third day in a row near the 20% cap.
watching: Gulf war diplomacy: Macron flew to Riyadh, Pakistan's army chief Munir carried proposals to Tehran, and four nations signed the Badr pact in Doha.
Ukraine: strike warnings were restored after the Oslo talks, NATO is reinforcing the Black Sea, and Russia freed an American prisoner.
Ebola in Nigeria: lawmakers are demanding emergency funds now that the outbreak has reached Abuja.
Pakistan: the fuel levy split, Jamaat's planned sit-ins and the continued detention of Imran Khan's sisters all point to more unrest.
The Armenia–Eurasian Economic Union standoff, with Moscow threatening trade measures against Yerevan.
El Niño readings are off the charts, according to the WMO in Geneva.
coverageGaps: Nine stories carry a country, state, county or region as their location instead of a city (United States ×2, China ×2, Netherlands, Nigeria, Pennsylvania, Orange County, Mason County), down from twelve yesterday. Tuning cannot fix this; it belongs in the writer or the validator.
Science had 3 stories and no medicine or health-science outlet among its sources, so the science-source gap noted on 2026-10-20 is still there.
Oceania had two datelines (Sydney and Wangaratta). Africa had six, but Sudan's war appears only through the Abyei market strike.
context: Every goal except the science count was met: freshness median 0.1 days, 33% multi-source, US datelines at 21% and Latin America at 5%, both at or inside their limits, and no duplicates or missing datelines. The quarantine held back one story. One story drew only on state or advocacy outlets (the CSTO Tajik border piece, sourced from TASS), and its body labels this. Cycles averaged 1009s, all five completed.
